funding.terms: Advance MM funding only. Token launches, developer buys and automated market making are inactive. Deposit only the 3× MM contribution; keep your developer-buy budget in your wallet. Funds are held in Twice operator wallets with internal per-project accounting, not separate on-chain escrow. The operator can withdraw these funds. Refunds require operator approval and sufficient remaining funds; they are not automatic or guaranteed. Network fees are additional.
